text: This solution, Assessment of Government Drought Risk Reduction and Mitigation Initiatives in Myanmar (2020–2025) addresses natural catastrophe in Myanmar between Department of Meteorology and Hydrology (DMH), Relief and Resettlement Department (RRD), Ministry of Social Welfare, Relief and Resettlement, Ministry of Agriculture, Livestock and Irrigation (MOALI), National Water Resources Committee (NWRC), State/Region and Township Disaster Management Committees, United Nations Development Programme (UNDP), United Nations Office for Disaster Risk Reduction (UNDRR), Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO), World Bank, and Asian Development Bank (ADB). The program was implemented in 2020 and focuses on collaboration and regulation.
